description: If \(W_r\) is extensional and \(e\in W_r\), the specified index \(\kappa(r,e)\) belongs to \(W_r\) and computes a subfunction of \(\varphi_e\). For some \(t\), it copies exactly the old partial values below \(t\) and diverges at all larger inputs; its graph is finite with at most \(t\) pairs.
